name: HIST 3540WE
title: Environmental History of the Americas
description: Transformations of one region within the Americas, such as the United States, Caribbean, or South America since 1450: the effects of human practices and policies, varying ideas about nature across cultures and time periods; and the rise of environmental movements. CA 1. CA 4. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to juniors or higher.
